references.text: Isaiah describes how God's word can fall on places (hearts) where it cannot take root, similar to those on rocky ground in Mark 4:16.
The book of Psalms speaks of one who is like a tree planted by water, in contrast to those who do not take root, as described in Mark 4:16.
Matthew 13:20-21 gives a parallel description of those who receive the word with joy but have no root, like those described in Mark 4:16.
Luke 8:13 offers a similar description of those who believe for a while but fall away in times of testing, paralleling those in Mark 4:16.
James speaks of being quick to hear but warns against not being enduring doers, which may reflect the situation in Mark 4:16.
